## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, what changes, and why.

## Verification

List exact commands, exit statuses, and the scope tested. Distinguish unit tests, compilation, GameTests, real-client tests, and visual review. State known failures and checks not run.

## Compatibility and persistence

Describe effects on profiles, saves, edits, revisions, cancellation, and renderer acknowledgement, if any.

## Publication review

- [ ] Public text and added comments are in English.
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, worlds, caches, third-party JARs, shader packs, or unapproved images are included.
- [ ] Contributions and assets have clear permission/provenance.
- [ ] Remaining risks and acceptance limits are stated.
